jury_interpretation_or_implementation_di.actual: Cycling shuffled train set, without replacement within each epoch; shared exact private batch stream across methods.
jury_interpretation_or_implementation_di.jury_text: With replacement from a finite train set.
jury_interpretation_or_implementation_di.resolution: Actual cycling behavior was explicit in the preregistration before launch; root confirmed it. This affects all methods equally.

jury_interpretation_or_implementation_di.actual: VG unit-column normalization with tangent gradient projection. Baselines retain pinned official training recipes; exported inference folds decoder norms.
jury_interpretation_or_implementation_di.jury_text: Unit decoder columns and radial-gradient projection consistently across methods.
jury_interpretation_or_implementation_di.resolution: Root instructed preservation of official baseline training, particularly the Anthropic norm-weighted recipe, before launch. Initial and evaluated training decoder norms are recorded.

jury_interpretation_or_implementation_di.actual: Common world seed resets for every model/control; architecture-specific initialization and decoder scales are retained.
jury_interpretation_or_implementation_di.jury_text: Share decoder initialization wherever API permits.
jury_interpretation_or_implementation_di.resolution: Same seeds do not imply identical initial weights across architectures. This pilot compares existing architecture recipes and does not isolate only the objective.

jury_interpretation_or_implementation_di.actual: Native achieved L0, recovery and fidelity at 500/1500/3000 updates for every model. VG evaluation objective, beta and floor-distance diagnostics at those checkpoints.
jury_interpretation_or_implementation_di.missing: Complete per-update beta/floor incidence and official baseline total-loss trajectories.
jury_interpretation_or_implementation_di.resolution: Do not claim per-update boundary-hit rates or demonstrated convergence. Checkpoint quality trajectories can identify nonstationarity but do not establish training convergence.

serialization_note: VG model_config dtype is the string torch.float32; strip the torch. prefix before passing it to VGSAEConfig. Model state itself contains float32 tensors.
baseline_recipe: Anthropic-style tanh JumpReLU with pre_act_loss_coefficient=3e-6, threshold=.1, bandwidth=2, tanh scale4, sparsity warmup1000, no input normalization. This is not the original paper's full recipe or budget.
comparison_scope: Equal controls, checkpoints, width, sample presentations and paired data; architecture-specific parameter counts, initialization and optimizer normalization rules remain part of each method.
